mentions.name: Gaming Couch
mentions.description: A local multiplayer party game platform blending Jackbox Games and Mario Party, with 18 competitive action-based mini-games in free Early Access. Players use mobile phones or gamepads as controllers, and everything is fully web-based with no downloads or installs. Rounds run about a minute each, and there are no language-based trivia games. Plans include opening the platform to third-party developers, with the platform handling network connectivity and controllers so developers can focus on building multiplayer mini-games.
mentions.problem: Third-party developers building multiplayer mini-games would otherwise spend an eternity on networking code and infrastructure.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on a local multiplayer party game platform, a lovechild of Jackbox Games and Mario Party: https://gamingcouch.com. We just won silver at the Big Indie Pitch competition!

- Currently in free Early Access with 18 competitive mini-games.
